Starter only. Turning the draw off or changing `exclusions` after the
names were drawn discards the draw: that is refused with `409` unless
`confirmRedraw: true`, which then redraws (and notifies every
participant) — or, with the draw turned off, simply clears it. New
exclusions that make every draw impossible are refused (`400`).
